Title: Boot sequence
Requirement: App boots deterministically: config -> services -> listeners; failures abort with coded exit

Title: Design doctrine
Requirement: All modules load config through OVR-002; no direct env reads outside the loader

Title: Config source of truth
Requirement: app.toml + env overrides exposed via load()/get(); typed access

Title: Auth session lane
Requirement: Sessions persist across restart; refresh before expiry; revocation list honored
